id: \bYou want some general tips? Hmm. Best tip I can give here is to expect the unexpected. They don't play by the meta of the main series games, they play by PoMas's meta.
en: \bYou want some general tips? Hmm. Best tip I can give here is to expect the unexpected. They don't play by the meta of the main series games, they play by PoMas's meta.
it: \bVuoi qualche consiglio generale? Mmh. Il miglior consiglio che posso darti è di aspettarti l'inaspettato. Non seguono il meta dei giochi principali, ma quello di PoMas.

id: \bFor example, they'll buff their stats up by a lot more than they probably should, invent new mechanics, ignore Protect and heal more than they should, just to name a few things.
en: \bFor example, they'll buff their stats up by a lot more than they probably should, invent new mechanics, ignore Protect and heal more than they should, just to name a few things.
it: \bPer esempio, aumentano le loro statistiche molto più di quanto dovrebbero, inventano nuove meccaniche, ignorano Protezione e si curano più del dovuto, solo per citarne alcune.

id: \bThey'll also have some interesting moves too, ranging from moves used by their trainers instead or powerful moves that can only be used under certain conditions.
en: \bThey'll also have some interesting moves too, ranging from moves used by their trainers instead or powerful moves that can only be used under certain conditions.
it: \bHanno anche delle mosse interessanti, che vanno da mosse usate dai loro Allenatori a mosse potenti utilizzabili solo in certe condizioni.

id: \bFuthermore, cheese moves like Destiny Bond and Perish Song won't work here; Knock Off also won't knock off their items. Don't try them!
en: \bFuthermore, cheese moves like Destiny Bond and Perish Song won't work here; Knock Off also won't knock off their items. Don't try them!
it: \bInoltre, mosse furbe come Destinobbligato e Ultimocanto qui non funzionano, e Privazione non toglie i loro strumenti. Non provarci nemmeno!

id: \bBut lastly, and you might find a silver lining in this - I've made it so that not only do you benefit from some damage reduction, the "harder" trainers have a lower chance to show up early.
en: \bBut lastly, and you might find a silver lining in this - I've made it so that not only do you benefit from some damage reduction, the "harder" trainers have a lower chance to show up early.
it: \bMa infine, e forse qui troverai un lato positivo: ho fatto in modo che tu non solo goda di una riduzione dei danni, ma che gli Allenatori "più tosti" abbiano meno probabilità di comparire presto.

id: \bSo if you want to familiarise yourself with the trainers here, it might be good to try this challenge with a lower difficulty first.
en: \bSo if you want to familiarise yourself with the trainers here, it might be good to try this challenge with a lower difficulty first.
it: \bQuindi, se vuoi prendere confidenza con gli Allenatori di qui, potrebbe convenirti provare prima questa sfida a una difficoltà più bassa.

id: \bIn any case, good luck, you'll need it.
en: \bIn any case, good luck, you'll need it.
it: \bIn ogni caso, buona fortuna, ne avrai bisogno.

id: \bSure. Which one would you like me to explain? \ch[1,-1,Crit Rate,Trainer Move,B Move,Passive Skill, Master Passive,Zone,Gradual Healing]
en: \bSure. Which one would you like me to explain? \ch[1,-1,Crit Rate,Trainer Move,B Move,Passive Skill, Master Passive,Zone,Gradual Healing]
it: \bCerto. Quale vuoi che ti spieghi? \ch[1,-1,Tasso Critico,Mossa Allenatore,Mossa B,Abilità Passiva, Passiva Master,Zona,Cura Graduale]

id: \bCrit Rate - how often a Pokémon lands a crit, up to a maximum of 3 stages.
en: \bCrit Rate - how often a Pokémon lands a crit, up to a maximum of 3 stages.
it: \bTasso Critico - la frequenza con cui un Pokémon mette a segno un brutto colpo, fino a un massimo di 3 livelli.

id: \bTrainer Move - A move that the trainer uses (rather than their Pokémon). These moves tend to buff the user's Pokémon or their team's side.
en: \bTrainer Move - A move that the trainer uses (rather than their Pokémon). These moves tend to buff the user's Pokémon or their team's side.
it: \bMossa Allenatore - Una mossa usata dall'Allenatore (invece che dal suo Pokémon). Di solito potenzia il Pokémon di chi la usa o il lato della sua squadra.

id: \bThey can be used even when the trainer's Pokémon is afflicted with a status condition.
en: \bThey can be used even when the trainer's Pokémon is afflicted with a status condition.
it: \bPossono essere usate anche quando il Pokémon dell'Allenatore è affetto da un problema di stato.

id: \bB Move - Stands for Buddy Move. You can identify them by the "descriptor" in the move's name, e.g. Origin Volt Tackle.
en: \bB Move - Stands for Buddy Move. You can identify them by the "descriptor" in the move's name, e.g. Origin Volt Tackle.
it: \bMossa B - Sta per Buddy Move, cioè Mossa Compagno. Le riconosci dal "descrittore" nel nome della mossa, es. Locomovolt Origine.

id: \bThey tend to do what the move they're based on does, but with increased power, added effects or the regular effect enhanced.
en: \bThey tend to do what the move they're based on does, but with increased power, added effects or the regular effect enhanced.
it: \bDi solito fanno ciò che fa la mossa su cui si basano, ma con potenza maggiore, effetti aggiuntivi o l'effetto normale potenziato.

id: \bThere's usually a condition that has to be met before each B Move can be used, so use that to your advantage to counter them!
en: \bThere's usually a condition that has to be met before each B Move can be used, so use that to your advantage to counter them!
it: \bDi solito c'è una condizione da soddisfare prima di poter usare ogni Mossa B, quindi sfruttala a tuo vantaggio per contrastarle!

id: \bIf they don't, they will likely have very little PP instead. Lastly, all trainers only have 1 B Move at most, but there is 1 exception.
en: \bIf they don't, they will likely have very little PP instead. Lastly, all trainers only have 1 B Move at most, but there is 1 exception.
it: \bSe non ce l'hanno, probabilmente avranno invece pochissimi PP. Infine, ogni Allenatore ha al massimo 1 Mossa B, ma c'è 1 eccezione.

id: Passive Skill - Essentially an extra ability, but they can't be ignored by effects such as Mold Breaker.
en: Passive Skill - Essentially an extra ability, but they can't be ignored by effects such as Mold Breaker.
it: Abilità Passiva - In pratica un'abilità extra, ma non può essere ignorata da effetti come Rompiforma.

id: \bHow many a Pokémon has is completely arbitrary, though I've tried to limit it to 3 at most, excluding Master Passives.
en: \bHow many a Pokémon has is completely arbitrary, though I've tried to limit it to 3 at most, excluding Master Passives.
it: \bIl numero che ne ha un Pokémon è del tutto arbitrario, anche se ho cercato di limitarlo a 3 al massimo, escluse le Passive Master.

id: \bMaster Passive - A Passive Skill that increases the team's damage dealt and reduces the damage taken.
en: \bMaster Passive - A Passive Skill that increases the team's damage dealt and reduces the damage taken.
it: \bPassiva Master - Un'Abilità Passiva che aumenta i danni inflitti dalla squadra e riduce quelli subiti.

id: \bThere are 3 types: Flag Bearer is for all moves and is 10% damage increase and 20% damage reduction.
en: \bThere are 3 types: Flag Bearer is for all moves and is 10% damage increase and 20% damage reduction.
it: \bCe ne sono 3 tipi: Portabandiera vale per tutte le mosse e dà un 10% di danni in più e un 20% di danni in meno.

id: \bPride is for physical moves and is 20% damage increase and 25% damage reduction.
en: \bPride is for physical moves and is 20% damage increase and 25% damage reduction.
it: \bOrgoglio vale per le mosse fisiche e dà un 20% di danni in più e un 25% di danni in meno.

id: \bLastly, Spirit is for special moves and is 20% damage increase and 25% damage reduction.
en: \bLastly, Spirit is for special moves and is 20% damage increase and 25% damage reduction.
it: \bInfine, Spirito vale per le mosse speciali e dà un 20% di danni in più e un 25% di danni in meno.

id: \bZone - A field effect like a weather or terrain, boosting moves of a certain type by 50%.
en: \bZone - A field effect like a weather or terrain, boosting moves of a certain type by 50%.
it: \bZona - Un effetto del campo, come il meteo o un campo, che potenzia del 50% le mosse di un certo tipo.

id: \bGradual Healing - The Pokémon recovers 1/16th of their max HP every turn. Think of it kinda like Leftovers.
en: \bGradual Healing - The Pokémon recovers 1/16th of their max HP every turn. Think of it kinda like Leftovers.
it: \bCura Graduale - Il Pokémon recupera 1/16 dei suoi PS massimi a ogni turno. Pensala un po' come gli Avanzi.

en: \bAnyway, his Trainer Move give his Tyranitar's +1 Defense and makes its next attack guaranteed to land and crit, but there are ways to get around it, like Protect.

en: \bTtar has 2 passives. One gives its moves a higher chance to apply their additional effects and the other prevents its stats from dropping in a sandstorm.

id: \bMisty also has a very basic kit. Her Trainer Move gives her Vaporeon +2 Defense and her side +2 Sp. Defense.
en: \bMisty also has a very basic kit. Her Trainer Move gives her Vaporeon +2 Defense and her side +2 Sp. Defense.
it: \bAnche Misty ha un kit molto semplice. La sua Mossa Allenatore dà al suo Vaporeon +2 in Difesa e al suo lato +2 in Difesa Speciale.

id: \bLastly, her Vaporeon's passives give it gradual healing when switching in as well as a chance to raise its Evasion after it uses a move.
en: \bLastly, her Vaporeon's passives give it gradual healing when switching in as well as a chance to raise its Evasion after it uses a move.

en: \bErika's Trainer Move gives her Leafeon's +2 Attack and +1 Crit Rate, but if the Sun's up, these stat increases are doubled.

id: \bLeafeon's ability is Chorophyll, so with the Sun up, her Leafeon's speed will be doubled.
en: \bLeafeon's ability is Chorophyll, so with the Sun up, her Leafeon's speed will be doubled.

id: \bThen, its passives don't allow status conditions to be inflicted on it as well as heal it after using a move.
en: \bThen, its passives don't allow status conditions to be inflicted on it as well as heal it after using a move.
it: \bPoi, le sue passive gli impediscono di subire problemi di stato e lo curano dopo che ha usato una mossa.

id: \bIn other words, you really don't want Leafeon in the Sun!
en: \bIn other words, you really don't want Leafeon in the Sun!
it: \bIn altre parole, non vuoi proprio trovarti contro Leafeon col sole!

en: \bRed's Trainer Move gives his Charizard's +3 Attack, Sp. Attack and Speed and +2 Crit Rate, though its Defense and Sp. Defense are lowered by -1.

id: \bHis Charizard also has passives which allow its moves to never miss and not require a rechage turn after using them.
en: \bHis Charizard also has passives which allow its moves to never miss and not require a rechage turn after using them.

id: \bKnow what that means? It's able to use Blast Burn. Every. Single. Turn. Have fun!
en: \bKnow what that means? It's able to use Blast Burn. Every. Single. Turn. Have fun!

en: \bRed actually has a second Sygna Suit in PoMas. His Trainer Move gives Pikachu +6 Attack and Gradual Healing.
it: \bIn realtà Red ha una seconda Sygna Suit in PoMas. La sua Mossa Allenatore dà a Pikachu +6 all'Attacco e la Cura Graduale.

id: \bPikachu can also Gigantamax, though it maxes less use of it here compared to PoMas, since there you only use 1 Dynamax move for each sync pair per battle.
en: \bPikachu can also Gigantamax, though it maxes less use of it here compared to PoMas, since there you only use 1 Dynamax move for each sync pair per battle.
it: \bPikachu può anche usare il Gigamax, anche se qui lo sfrutta meno rispetto a PoMas, dato che lì si usa solo 1 Mossa Dynamax per unità in ogni lotta.

id: \bIt also has a Flag Bearer Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
en: \bIt also has a Flag Bearer Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.

en: \bIts other passives make all its moves critical hits, as well as healing it after it uses a move in Electric Terrain.

en: \bBlue's Trainer Move gives his side +2 Defense and +1 Crit Rate, as well as setting up Tailwind on his side.

id: \bLugia has passives which makes its single target attacks hit all opponents as well as restore PP to Ethan's Trainer Move.
en: \bLugia has passives which makes its single target attacks hit all opponents as well as restore PP to Ethan's Trainer Move.
it: \bLugia ha passive che fanno colpire tutti gli avversari ai suoi attacchi a bersaglio singolo e che ripristinano i PP della Mossa Allenatore di Ethan.

id: \bLastly, it also has a Spirit Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
en: \bLastly, it also has a Spirit Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
it: \bInfine, ha anche la Passiva Master Spirito. Consulta la sezione Termini chiave per sapere cosa significa.

id: \bLyra's Trainer Move gives +2 Attack and Sp. Attack to a Pokémon on her side and gives them Gradual Healing. But that's not the crazy thing about this sync pair.
en: \bLyra's Trainer Move gives +2 Attack and Sp. Attack to a Pokémon on her side and gives them Gradual Healing. But that's not the crazy thing about this sync pair.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Lyra dà +2 all'Attacco e all'Attacco Speciale a un Pokémon dalla sua parte e gli conferisce la Cura Graduale. Ma non è questa la cosa folle di questa unità.

id: \bCelebi has passives which leaves the opponent flinched, trapped and confused after using a move and lowers one of the target's stats by -2.
en: \bCelebi has passives which leaves the opponent flinched, trapped and confused after using a move and lowers one of the target's stats by -2.
it: \bCelebi ha passive che, dopo che usa una mossa, fanno tentennare, intrappolano e confondono l'avversario, e abbassano di 2 una delle statistiche del bersaglio.

id: \bAnnnnd Celebi has Grassy Glide and can set up Grassy Terrain too to give it priority. Talk about a nasty combo!
en: \bAnnnnd Celebi has Grassy Glide and can set up Grassy Terrain too to give it priority. Talk about a nasty combo!
it: \bEeee Celebi ha Erboscivolata e può anche attivare il Campo Erboso per darle la priorità. Che combo micidiale!

id: \bLastly, it also has a Pride Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
en: \bLastly, it also has a Pride Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
it: \bInfine, ha anche la Passiva Master Orgoglio. Consulta la sezione Termini chiave per sapere cosa significa.

id: \bIf you face her, pray that the other sync pairs are physical attackers.
en: \bIf you face her, pray that the other sync pairs are physical attackers.
it: \bSe la affronti, prega che le altre unità siano attaccanti fisici.

id: \bAt base, her Trainer Move gives her side +2 Sp. Attack and +1 Crit Rate.
en: \bAt base, her Trainer Move gives her side +2 Sp. Attack and +1 Crit Rate.
it: \bDi base, la sua Mossa Allenatore dà al suo lato +2 all'Attacco Speciale e +1 al tasso di brutti colpi.

id: \bBut if it's Raining, it also powers up the next special attack from her team, making them pack an even bigger punch.
en: \bBut if it's Raining, it also powers up the next special attack from her team, making them pack an even bigger punch.
it: \bMa se c'è la Pioggia, potenzia anche il prossimo attacco speciale della sua squadra, rendendolo ancora più devastante.

id: \bOne of Suicune's passives gives its side +4 Sp. Defense if it successfully uses a status move the first time its used in battle.
en: \bOne of Suicune's passives gives its side +4 Sp. Defense if it successfully uses a status move the first time its used in battle.
it: \bUna delle passive di Suicune dà al suo lato +4 alla Difesa Speciale se riesce a usare una mossa di stato la prima volta che la usa in lotta.

id: \bIts other passive heals its team after a uses a move under the Rain. I think you get the idea - Rain is dangerous if you're facing Kris!
en: \bIts other passive heals its team after a uses a move under the Rain. I think you get the idea - Rain is dangerous if you're facing Kris!
it: \bL'altra passiva cura la sua squadra dopo che usa una mossa sotto la Pioggia. Credo tu abbia capito: la Pioggia è pericolosa se affronti Kris!

id: \bLastly, it has a Flag Bearer Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
en: \bLastly, it has a Flag Bearer Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
it: \bInfine, ha la Passiva Master Portabandiera. Consulta la sezione Termini chiave per sapere cosa significa.

id: \bSilver's Trainer Move gives Sneasel +3 Attack and Speed, as well as setting up Tailwind on his side.
en: \bSilver's Trainer Move gives Sneasel +3 Attack and Speed, as well as setting up Tailwind on his side.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Silver dà a Sneasel +3 all'Attacco e alla Velocità, e attiva Ventoincoda dalla sua parte.

id: \bSneasel's B Move, Crushing Tripel Axel, can only be used when its HP is full. In theory, that doesn't sound too hard to counter, right?
en: \bSneasel's B Move, Crushing Tripel Axel, can only be used when its HP is full. In theory, that doesn't sound too hard to counter, right?
it: \bLa Mossa B di Sneasel, Triplo Axel Schiacciante, si può usare solo quando ha i PS al massimo. In teoria non sembra troppo difficile da contrastare, giusto?

id: \bWell, on every hit of a multi-hit move, its passives lower the opposing Pokémon's Speed by -1 while it gets +1 Evasion.
en: \bWell, on every hit of a multi-hit move, its passives lower the opposing Pokémon's Speed by -1 while it gets +1 Evasion.
it: \bBeh, a ogni colpo di una mossa multicolpo, le sue passive abbassano di 1 la Velocità del Pokémon avversario mentre lui ottiene +1 all'Elusione.

id: \bIt also gets +1 Crit Rate on each hit of its B Move too, but it doesn't have any other ways of increasing its damage itself.
en: \bIt also gets +1 Crit Rate on each hit of its B Move too, but it doesn't have any other ways of increasing its damage itself.
it: \bOttiene anche +1 al tasso di brutti colpi a ogni colpo della sua Mossa B, ma non ha altri modi per aumentare da solo i suoi danni.

id: \bSo at best, you get lucky and OHKO it, while at worst, it's a nuisance.
en: \bSo at best, you get lucky and OHKO it, while at worst, it's a nuisance.
it: \bQuindi, nel migliore dei casi ti va bene e lo metti KO in un colpo solo, nel peggiore è una bella seccatura.

id: \bGiovanni's Trainer Move gives his Nidoking +6 Attack.
en: \bGiovanni's Trainer Move gives his Nidoking +6 Attack.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Giovanni dà al suo Nidoking +6 all'Attacco.

id: \bHis Nidoking has a passive to make all its attacks critical hits, including its Max Moves.
en: \bHis Nidoking has a passive to make all its attacks critical hits, including its Max Moves.
it: \bIl suo Nidoking ha una passiva che trasforma tutti i suoi attacchi in brutti colpi, comprese le Mosse Dynamax.

id: \bIts other passive turns Normal moves into Ground moves, allowing it to gain STAB from it. Its Mega Kick is going to hit pretty hard!
en: \bIts other passive turns Normal moves into Ground moves, allowing it to gain STAB from it. Its Mega Kick is going to hit pretty hard!
it: \bL'altra passiva trasforma le mosse di tipo Normale in mosse di tipo Terra, così ottiene il bonus STAB. Il suo Megacalcio colpirà parecchio forte!

id: \bThis version of Giovanni has a Trainer Move which gives his side +2 Attack and Sp. Attack, as well as making Guzzlord the center of attention.
en: \bThis version of Giovanni has a Trainer Move which gives his side +2 Attack and Sp. Attack, as well as making Guzzlord the center of attention.
it: \bQuesta versione di Giovanni ha una Mossa Allenatore che dà al suo lato +2 all'Attacco e all'Attacco Speciale, e rende Guzzlord il centro dell'attenzione.

id: \bGuzzlord has passives which enable its Stockpile Defense and Sp. Defense boosts to be tripled and shared with its allies.
en: \bGuzzlord has passives which enable its Stockpile Defense and Sp. Defense boosts to be tripled and shared with its allies.
it: \bGuzzlord ha passive che triplicano gli aumenti di Difesa e Difesa Speciale di Accumulo e li condividono con i suoi alleati.

id: \bHowever, it can only Stockpile a maximum of 2 times as a result of this.
en: \bHowever, it can only Stockpile a maximum of 2 times as a result of this.
it: \bDi conseguenza, però, può usare Accumulo al massimo 2 volte.

id: \bGuzzlord also doesn't have just 1 B Move, but 2! It's the one exception to the "rule" that says there can only be 1 B Move for each sync pair.
en: \bGuzzlord also doesn't have just 1 B Move, but 2! It's the one exception to the "rule" that says there can only be 1 B Move for each sync pair.
it: \bGuzzlord, poi, non ha solo 1 Mossa B, ma 2! È l'unica eccezione alla "regola" secondo cui può esserci solo 1 Mossa B per ogni unità.

id: \bWhen used, they both remove Stockpiles's stat boosts and restores 1 PP to Giovanni's Trainer Move.
en: \bWhen used, they both remove Stockpiles's stat boosts and restores 1 PP to Giovanni's Trainer Move.
it: \bQuando vengono usate, entrambe annullano gli aumenti di Accumulo e ripristinano 1 PP della Mossa Allenatore di Giovanni.

id: \bThe first one, Guzzling Swallow, can only be used after Stockpile has been used and restores Guzzlord's HP based on how many times it was used.
en: \bThe first one, Guzzling Swallow, can only be used after Stockpile has been used and restores Guzzlord's HP based on how many times it was used.
it: \bLa prima, Introenergia Vorace, si può usare solo dopo aver usato Accumulo e ripristina i PS di Guzzlord in base a quante volte è stato usato.

id: \bThen, it restores a fixed amount of HP for its allies.
en: \bThen, it restores a fixed amount of HP for its allies.
it: \bPoi ripristina una quantità fissa di PS ai suoi alleati.

id: \bThe second one is Gourging Crunch. It can only be used when the Guzzlord's stat boosts for Defense and Sp. Defense are 6 or greater.
en: \bThe second one is Gourging Crunch. It can only be used when the Guzzlord's stat boosts for Defense and Sp. Defense are 6 or greater.
it: \bLa seconda è Sgranocchio Ingordo. Si può usare solo quando gli aumenti di Difesa e Difesa Speciale di Guzzlord sono pari o superiori a 6.

id: \bIt then lowers the target's defensive stats by -1.
en: \bIt then lowers the target's defensive stats by -1.
it: \bPoi abbassa di 1 le statistiche difensive del bersaglio.

id: \bPick a trainer.\n\ch[1,-1,May,Brendan,Steven,Wally]
en: \bPick a trainer.\n\ch[1,-1,May,Brendan,Steven,Wally]
it: \bScegli un Allenatore.\n\ch[1,-1,Vera,Brendan,Rocco,Valentino]

id: \bMay's Trainer Move gives her Blaziken +4 Attack and +1 Accuracy, sets up Tailwind and protects it from damage for the rest of the turn.
en: \bMay's Trainer Move gives her Blaziken +4 Attack and +1 Accuracy, sets up Tailwind and protects it from damage for the rest of the turn.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Vera dà al suo Blaziken +4 all'Attacco e +1 alla Precisione, attiva Ventoincoda e lo protegge dai danni per il resto del turno.

id: \bBlaziken's first passive gives +1 Speed to its side when entering battle, including Mega Evolution, effectively translating to a +2 increase.
en: \bBlaziken's first passive gives +1 Speed to its side when entering battle, including Mega Evolution, effectively translating to a +2 increase.
it: \bLa prima passiva di Blaziken dà +1 alla Velocità al suo lato quando entra in lotta, anche con la Megaevoluzione, il che si traduce in un aumento di +2.

id: \bIts other passive lowers the target's Defense by -2. All in all, very speedy and it can easily snowball if you're not careful.
en: \bIts other passive lowers the target's Defense by -2. All in all, very speedy and it can easily snowball if you're not careful.
it: \bL'altra passiva abbassa di 2 la Difesa del bersaglio. Tutto sommato è velocissimo e può prendere il sopravvento in un attimo se non stai attento.

id: \bBrendan's Trainer Move gives his side +4 Sp. Attack and Sp. Defense as well as +1 Crit Rate.
en: \bBrendan's Trainer Move gives his side +4 Sp. Attack and Sp. Defense as well as +1 Crit Rate.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Brendan dà al suo lato +4 all'Attacco Speciale e alla Difesa Speciale e +1 al tasso di brutti colpi.

id: \bHis Latios's first passive powers up its sides' next special moves when entering the battle and Mega Evolving.
en: \bHis Latios's first passive powers up its sides' next special moves when entering the battle and Mega Evolving.
it: \bLa prima passiva del suo Latios potenzia le prossime mosse speciali del suo lato quando entra in lotta e quando megaevolve.

id: \bIts other passive then increases the likelihood of additional effects; if it's a stat drop, it'll be doubled too.
en: \bIts other passive then increases the likelihood of additional effects; if it's a stat drop, it'll be doubled too.
it: \bL'altra passiva aumenta la probabilità degli effetti aggiuntivi; se si tratta di un calo di statistiche, verrà anche raddoppiato.

id: \bIt has Luster Purge, so that'll mean that you'll be taking a lot of special damage if you're not careful!
en: \bIt has Luster Purge, so that'll mean that you'll be taking a lot of special damage if you're not careful!
it: \bHa Abbagliante, quindi subirai un sacco di danni speciali se non stai attento!

id: \bSteven... is a lot. Because he has a Deoxys, PoMas decided to give him not just 1 form of Deoxys, but all 4! So let's break him down a bit.\ch[2,-1,Initial State,Shared Traits, Normal Forme,Attack Forme,Defense Forme,Speed Forme]
en: \bSteven... is a lot. Because he has a Deoxys, PoMas decided to give him not just 1 form of Deoxys, but all 4! So let's break him down a bit.\ch[2,-1,Initial State,Shared Traits, Normal Forme,Attack Forme,Defense Forme,Speed Forme]
it: \bRocco... è tanta roba. Dato che ha un Deoxys, PoMas ha deciso di dargli non solo 1 forma di Deoxys, ma tutte e 4! Quindi analizziamolo un po'.\ch[2,-1,Stato iniziale,Tratti comuni, Forma Normale,Forma Attacco,Forma Difesa,Forma Velocità]

id: \bInitially, Deoxys starts in its Normal Forme with 4 Trainer Moves and a passive which gives it +1 Accuracy when switching in.
en: \bInitially, Deoxys starts in its Normal Forme with 4 Trainer Moves and a passive which gives it +1 Accuracy when switching in.
it: \bAll'inizio, Deoxys parte in Forma Normale con 4 Mosse Allenatore e una passiva che gli dà +1 alla Precisione quando entra in campo.

id: \bThe first one, "Try This!", sets Psychic Terrain and gives Deoxys +2 Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed and keep Deoxys in its Normal Forme.
en: \bThe first one, "Try This!", sets Psychic Terrain and gives Deoxys +2 Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed and keep Deoxys in its Normal Forme.
it: \bLa prima, "Prova questa!", attiva il Campo Psichico, dà a Deoxys +2 alla Difesa, all'Att. Sp., alla Dif. Sp. e alla Velocità e lo mantiene in Forma Normale.

id: \bHis second one, "Attack!", gives Deoxys +6 Sp. Attack and +3 Crit Rate, then changes Deoxys into Attack Forme.
en: \bHis second one, "Attack!", gives Deoxys +6 Sp. Attack and +3 Crit Rate, then changes Deoxys into Attack Forme.
it: \bLa seconda, "Attacca!", dà a Deoxys +6 all'Attacco Speciale e +3 al tasso di brutti colpi, poi lo trasforma in Forma Attacco.

id: \bThe third one, "Defend!" gives its +4 side Attack and Sp. Attack. Deoxys then changes into its Defense Form and protects itself from damage for the rest of the turn.
en: \bThe third one, "Defend!" gives its +4 side Attack and Sp. Attack. Deoxys then changes into its Defense Form and protects itself from damage for the rest of the turn.
it: \bLa terza, "Difendi!", dà al suo lato +4 all'Attacco e all'Attacco Speciale. Poi Deoxys passa alla Forma Difesa e si protegge dai danni per il resto del turno.

id: \bLast but not least,"Faster!", gives Deoxys +6 Speed and +3 Evasion and changes Deoxys into its Speed Forme.
en: \bLast but not least,"Faster!", gives Deoxys +6 Speed and +3 Evasion and changes Deoxys into its Speed Forme.
it: \bInfine, ma non meno importante, "Più veloce!" dà a Deoxys +6 alla Velocità e +3 all'Elusione e lo trasforma in Forma Velocità.

id: \bOutside of its inital state, all forms of Deoxys that Steven has have a passive with converts stat drops into stat increases, but not vice versa like Contrary does!
en: \bOutside of its inital state, all forms of Deoxys that Steven has have a passive with converts stat drops into stat increases, but not vice versa like Contrary does!
it: \bA parte lo stato iniziale, tutte le forme del Deoxys di Rocco hanno una passiva che converte i cali di statistiche in aumenti, ma non viceversa come fa Inversione!

id: \bThey all also have Psycho Boost and Zen Headbutt, so I won't be mentioning them elsewhere.
en: \bThey all also have Psycho Boost and Zen Headbutt, so I won't be mentioning them elsewhere.
it: \bHanno tutte anche Psicoslancio e Cozzata Zen, quindi non le menzionerò altrove.

id: \bIn its Normal Forme, Deoxys has Recover and Cosmic Power in addition to the common moves.
en: \bIn its Normal Forme, Deoxys has Recover and Cosmic Power in addition to the common moves.
it: \bIn Forma Normale, Deoxys ha Ripresa e Cosmoforza oltre alle mosse comuni.

id: \bIt also has a passive which increase the chance of additional effects, so if it uses Zen Headbutt, be prepared to flinch!
en: \bIt also has a passive which increase the chance of additional effects, so if it uses Zen Headbutt, be prepared to flinch!
it: \bHa anche una passiva che aumenta la probabilità degli effetti aggiuntivi, quindi se usa Cozzata Zen, preparati a tentennare!

id: \bIn its Attack Forme, Deoxys has Protect and Cosmic Power in addition to the common moves.
en: \bIn its Attack Forme, Deoxys has Protect and Cosmic Power in addition to the common moves.
it: \bIn Forma Attacco, Deoxys ha Protezione e Cosmoforza oltre alle mosse comuni.

id: \bIt also has a passive which increases the power of its next physical and special moves, so it might quickly snowball out of control!
en: \bIt also has a passive which increases the power of its next physical and special moves, so it might quickly snowball out of control!
it: \bHa anche una passiva che aumenta la potenza delle sue prossime mosse fisiche e speciali, quindi potrebbe diventare rapidamente inarrestabile!

id: \bIn its Defense Forme, Deoxys has Recover and Iron Defense in addition to the common moves.
en: \bIn its Defense Forme, Deoxys has Recover and Iron Defense in addition to the common moves.
it: \bIn Forma Difesa, Deoxys ha Ripresa e Ferroscudo oltre alle mosse comuni.

id: \bIt also has a passive which gives its side +2 Sp. Defense each time a status move is used, so with Iron Defense it'll become very bulky very quickly.
en: \bIt also has a passive which gives its side +2 Sp. Defense each time a status move is used, so with Iron Defense it'll become very bulky very quickly.
it: \bHa anche una passiva che dà al suo lato +2 alla Difesa Speciale ogni volta che viene usata una mossa di stato, quindi con Ferroscudo diventerà coriaceo molto in fretta.

id: \bIn its Speed Forme, Deoxys has Recover and Double Team in addition to the common moves.
en: \bIn its Speed Forme, Deoxys has Recover and Double Team in addition to the common moves.
it: \bIn Forma Velocità, Deoxys ha Ripresa e Doppioteam oltre alle mosse comuni.

id: \bIt also has a passive which sets up Tailwind for its side when a status move is successful the first time it's used in battle.
en: \bIt also has a passive which sets up Tailwind for its side when a status move is successful the first time it's used in battle.
it: \bHa anche una passiva che attiva Ventoincoda dalla sua parte quando una mossa di stato va a segno la prima volta che viene usata in lotta.

id: \bWally's Trainer Move gives his Gardevoir +2 Sp. Attack and +1 Sp. Defense and Crit Rate.
en: \bWally's Trainer Move gives his Gardevoir +2 Sp. Attack and +1 Sp. Defense and Crit Rate.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Valentino dà al suo Gardevoir +2 all'Attacco Speciale e +1 alla Difesa Speciale e al tasso di brutti colpi.

id: \bGardevoir has 2 passives - the first gives its side +1 Speed when entering battle and Mega Evolving; the other leaves the target confused after a move.
en: \bGardevoir has 2 passives - the first gives its side +1 Speed when entering battle and Mega Evolving; the other leaves the target confused after a move.
it: \bGardevoir ha 2 passive: la prima dà al suo lato +1 alla Velocità quando entra in lotta e quando megaevolve; l'altra confonde il bersaglio dopo una mossa.

id: \bGardevoir also has a B Move, Ultimate Dazzling Gleam. It lowers the targets' Attack and Sp. Attack by -4, then makes them weaker to Fairy type attacks.
en: \bGardevoir also has a B Move, Ultimate Dazzling Gleam. It lowers the targets' Attack and Sp. Attack by -4, then makes them weaker to Fairy type attacks.
it: \bGardevoir ha anche una Mossa B, Magibrillio Supremo. Abbassa di 4 l'Attacco e l'Attacco Speciale dei bersagli, poi li rende più vulnerabili agli attacchi di tipo Folletto.

id: \bIt can only be used once, but you can't Protect against it and -4 on your attacking stats will likely force you to switch out your Pokémon.
en: \bIt can only be used once, but you can't Protect against it and -4 on your attacking stats will likely force you to switch out your Pokémon.
it: \bSi può usare una sola volta, ma non puoi proteggerti con Protezione e un -4 alle statistiche offensive probabilmente ti costringerà a cambiare Pokémon.

id: \bPick a trainer.\n\ch[1,-1,Cynthia,Cynthia (Renegade),Cynthia (Aura),Cyrus,Dawn]
en: \bPick a trainer.\n\ch[1,-1,Cynthia,Cynthia (Renegade),Cynthia (Aura),Cyrus,Dawn]
it: \bScegli un Allenatore.\n\ch[1,-1,Camilla,Camilla (Rinnegata),Camilla (Aura),Cyrus,Lucinda]

id: \bCynthia's Trainer Move, which I took some creative liberties with, raises her Kommo-o's Crit Rate and boosts its next special attack depending on how low its HP is.
en: \bCynthia's Trainer Move, which I took some creative liberties with, raises her Kommo-o's Crit Rate and boosts its next special attack depending on how low its HP is.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di Camilla, con cui mi sono preso qualche libertà creativa, aumenta il tasso di brutti colpi del suo Kommo-o e potenzia il suo prossimo attacco speciale in base a quanto sono bassi i suoi PS.

id: \bApart from that, Kommo-o has passives which allow it to ignore damage reduction from Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil as well as increase the chance for additional effects.
en: \bApart from that, Kommo-o has passives which allow it to ignore damage reduction from Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil as well as increase the chance for additional effects.
it: \bA parte questo, Kommo-o ha passive che gli permettono di ignorare la riduzione dei danni di Riflesso, Schermoluce e Velaurora, e di aumentare la probabilità degli effetti aggiuntivi.

id: \bThis version of Cynthia's Trainer Move gives Giratina +4 Attack and Sp. Attack and +3 Crit Rate. She can also set a Ghost Zone.
en: \bThis version of Cynthia's Trainer Move gives Giratina +4 Attack and Sp. Attack and +3 Crit Rate. She can also set a Ghost Zone.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di questa versione di Camilla dà a Giratina +4 all'Attacco e all'Attacco Speciale e +3 al tasso di brutti colpi. Può anche attivare una Zona Spettro.

id: \bHer Giratina's attacks lower the Defense and Sp. Defense of the target by -1.
en: \bHer Giratina's attacks lower the Defense and Sp. Defense of the target by -1.
it: \bGli attacchi del suo Giratina abbassano di 1 la Difesa e la Difesa Speciale del bersaglio.

id: \bThis Cynthia's Trainer Move gives her side +4 Defense and Sp. Defense, but if a Fighting Zone is active, she'll give +6 instead.
en: \bThis Cynthia's Trainer Move gives her side +4 Defense and Sp. Defense, but if a Fighting Zone is active, she'll give +6 instead.
it: \bLa Mossa Allenatore di questa Camilla dà al suo lato +4 alla Difesa e alla Difesa Speciale, ma se è attiva una Zona Lotta, darà invece +6.

id: \bAs for that, her Lucario has a passive which sets Fighting Zone on entry, so most of the time, it'll be +6.
en: \bAs for that, her Lucario has a passive which sets Fighting Zone on entry, so most of the time, it'll be +6.
it: \bA tal proposito, il suo Lucario ha una passiva che attiva la Zona Lotta quando entra in campo, quindi la maggior parte delle volte sarà +6.

id: \bLucario's other passive also depends on Fighting Zone - it heals its side after using a move if it's active.
en: \bLucario's other passive also depends on Fighting Zone - it heals its side after using a move if it's active.
it: \bAnche l'altra passiva di Lucario dipende dalla Zona Lotta: se è attiva, cura il suo lato dopo che usa una mossa.

id: \bIt also has Superior Aura Sphere, a B Move that never misses and can only be used after Lucario is attacked twice.
en: \bIt also has Superior Aura Sphere, a B Move that never misses and can only be used after Lucario is attacked twice.
it: \bHa anche Forzasfera Superiore, una Mossa B che non manca mai il bersaglio e si può usare solo dopo che Lucario è stato attaccato due volte.

id: \bAfter it deals damage, it powers up the next physical and special attacks of its side.
en: \bAfter it deals damage, it powers up the next physical and special attacks of its side.
it: \bDopo aver inflitto danni, potenzia i prossimi attacchi fisici e speciali del suo lato.

id: \bLastly, Lucario has a Flag Bearer Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
en: \bLastly, Lucario has a Flag Bearer Master Passive. Refer to the Key Terms section to know what that means.
it: \bInfine, Lucario ha la Passiva Master Portabandiera. Consulta la sezione Termini chiave per sapere cosa significa.

id: \bCyrus's Trainer Move gives his Darkrai +2 Sp. Attack and +1 Accuracy and Crit Rate. In addition, he can set a Dark Zone.
en: \bCyrus's Trainer Move gives his Darkrai +2 Sp. Attack and +1 Accuracy and Crit Rate. In addition, he can set a Dark Zone.

id: \bSince I realised the the difficulty of the Sync Challenge was a mistake, I've given you some buffs to help you out.
en: \bSince I realised the the difficulty of the Sync Challenge was a mistake, I've given you some buffs to help you out.
it: \bVisto che ho capito che la difficoltà della Sfida Sync era un errore, ti ho dato qualche bonus per darti una mano.

id: \bEssentially, you have 7 energy worth of buffs. There are 5 types of buffs: Blessings, Immunities, Restoration, Boosters and Crushers.
en: \bEssentially, you have 7 energy worth of buffs.  There are 5 types of buffs: Blessings, Immunities, Restoration, Boosters and Crushers.
it: \bIn pratica, hai 7 punti energia da spendere in bonus.  Ci sono 5 tipi di bonus: Benedizioni, Immunità, Recupero, Potenziatori e Demolitori.

id: \bWhat buff type would you like to know about? \ch[1,-1,Blessings,Immunities,Restoration,Boosters, Crushers]
en: \bWhat buff type would you like to know about? \ch[1,-1,Blessings,Immunities,Restoration,Boosters, Crushers]
it: \bDi quale tipo di bonus vuoi sapere di più? \ch[1,-1,Benedizioni,Immunità,Recupero,Potenziatori, Demolitori]

id: \bBlessings give your Pokémon stat increases at the start of a battle and they use energy corresponding with their level.
en: \bBlessings give your Pokémon stat increases at the start of a battle and they use energy corresponding with their level.
it: \bLe Benedizioni aumentano le statistiche dei tuoi Pokémon all'inizio della battaglia e consumano energia in base al loro livello.

id: \bIn addition, you can buy an enhanced version of the buff (apart from the Assasin's Blessing) for just a few more of your hard-earned credits.
en: \bIn addition, you can buy an enhanced version of the buff (apart from the Assasin's Blessing) for just a few more of your hard-earned credits.
it: \bInoltre, puoi comprare una versione migliorata del bonus (tranne la Benedizione dell'Assassino) per pochi crediti in più, sudati con fatica.

id: \bAs an example, Warrior's Blessing Lv. 1 will give your Pokémon +1 Attack when they enter battle, essentially giving them Intrepid Sword!
en: \bAs an example, Warrior's Blessing Lv. 1 will give your Pokémon +1 Attack when they enter battle, essentially giving them Intrepid Sword!
it: \bPer esempio, Benedizione del Guerriero Lv. 1 darà ai tuoi Pokémon +1 all'Attacco quando entrano in battaglia: in pratica, Spada Indomita!

id: \bImmunites make your Pokémon immune to status conditions, "interferences" (i.e. flinching, trapping and confusion) or even critical hits for some time.
en: \bImmunites make your Pokémon immune to status conditions, "interferences" (i.e. flinching, trapping and confusion) or even critical hits for some time.
it: \bLe Immunità rendono i tuoi Pokémon immuni ai problemi di stato, alle "interferenze" (cioè tentennamento, intrappolamento e confusione) o perfino ai brutti colpi per un certo periodo.

id: \bAll of them use 2 energy and can't be upgraded further like Blessings can.
en: \bAll of them use 2 energy and can't be upgraded further like Blessings can.
it: \bConsumano tutte 2 punti energia e non si possono migliorare come le Benedizioni.

id: \bHowever, once you buy out the whole store, you can then buy buffs that make you immune to all status conditions and interferences.
en: \bHowever, once you buy out the whole store, you can then buy buffs that make you immune to all status conditions and interferences.
it: \bPerò, una volta che avrai comprato tutto il negozio, potrai acquistare bonus che ti rendono immune a tutti i problemi di stato e a tutte le interferenze.

id: \bThey will use up 4 and 3 energy respectively, though.
en: \bThey will use up 4 and 3 energy respectively, though.
it: \bConsumeranno però rispettivamente 4 e 3 punti energia.

id: \bIf you talk to Nurse Joy now, she'll actually heal your team now! But... just a little bit, if you don't give her any energy. Better than nothing though, amirite?
en: \bIf you talk to Nurse Joy now, she'll actually heal your team now! But... just a little bit, if you don't give her any energy. Better than nothing though, amirite?
it: \bSe adesso parli con l'Infermiera Joy, curerà davvero la tua squadra! Ma... solo un pochino, se non le dai energia. Meglio di niente, no?

id: \bAt base, she'll heal your team for 10% of its HP, as well as restore 1/8 of its PP (restoring at least 1 PP per move, though).
en: \bAt base, she'll heal your team for 10% of its HP, as well as restore 1/8 of its PP (restoring at least 1 PP per move, though).
it: \bDi base, curerà il 10% dei PS della tua squadra e ripristinerà 1/8 dei PP (almeno 1 PP per mossa, comunque).

id: \bThe restoration buffs increase those amounts though. For each level of the HP Recovery buff, she'll heal 25%, 50% and 100% of your team's HP.
en: \bThe restoration buffs increase those amounts though. For each level of the HP Recovery buff, she'll heal 25%, 50% and 100% of your team's HP.
it: \bI bonus di Recupero aumentano queste quantità. Per ogni livello del bonus Recupero PS, curerà il 25%, il 50% e il 100% dei PS della tua squadra.

id: \bHowever, your fainted mons will only receive 10% of their max HP regardless of whether or not you have a HP Restoration buff. So keep your 'mons alive!
en: \bHowever, your fainted mons will only receive 10% of their max HP regardless of whether or not you have a HP Restoration buff. So keep your 'mons alive!
it: \bPerò i tuoi Pokémon esausti riceveranno solo il 10% dei loro PS massimi, che tu abbia o meno un bonus Recupero PS. Quindi tieni in vita i tuoi Pokémon!

id: \bFor each level of the PP Recovery buff, it'll restore 1/4, 1/2 and all of your team's PP respectively.
en: \bFor each level of the PP Recovery buff, it'll restore 1/4, 1/2 and all of your team's PP respectively.
it: \bPer ogni livello del bonus Recupero PP, ripristinerà rispettivamente 1/4, 1/2 e tutti i PP della tua squadra.

id: \bFurthermore, she also won't remove status conditions from your team; you'll have to equip the Status Recovery buff first! It costs 3 energy.
en: \bFurthermore, she also won't remove status conditions from your team; you'll have to equip the Status Recovery buff first! It costs 3 energy.
it: \bInoltre, non curerà i problemi di stato della tua squadra: prima dovrai equipaggiare il bonus Recupero Stato! Costa 3 punti energia.

id: \bLastly, these buffs are only active in the Sync Challenge. If she gave any healing in the Titan Challenge, it would be wayyy too easy!
en: \bLastly, these buffs are only active in the Sync Challenge. If she gave any healing in the Titan Challenge, it would be wayyy too easy!
it: \bInfine, questi bonus sono attivi solo nella Sfida Sync. Se curasse anche nella Sfida dei Titani, sarebbe fiiin troppo facile!

id: \bBoosters give your Pokémon +1 to a stat (except Accuracy and Evasion) after they use a move, even if the move failed.
en: \bBoosters give your Pokémon +1 to a stat (except Accuracy and Evasion) after they use a move, even if the move failed.
it: \bI Potenziatori danno ai tuoi Pokémon +1 a una statistica (tranne Precisione ed Elusione) dopo che hanno usato una mossa, anche se la mossa fallisce.

id: \bAll of them use 1 energy and can't be upgraded further like Blessings can.
en: \bAll of them use 1 energy and can't be upgraded further like Blessings can.
it: \bConsumano tutti 1 punto energia e non si possono migliorare come le Benedizioni.

id: \bCrushers lowers one of the target's stats (except Accuracy and Evasion) by -1 after they're attacked.
en: \bCrushers lowers one of the target's stats (except Accuracy and Evasion) by -1 after they're attacked.
it: \bI Demolitori riducono di 1 una delle statistiche del bersaglio (tranne Precisione ed Elusione) dopo che è stato attaccato.

id: \bAlso, they won't be effective in Titan Challenge; all opponents there are immune to stat drops.
en: \bAlso, they won't be effective in Titan Challenge; all opponents there are immune to stat drops.
it: \bInoltre, non avranno effetto nella Sfida dei Titani: lì tutti gli avversari sono immuni ai cali delle statistiche.

id: \bIn this challenge specifically, you also won't be able to inflict your opponents with status conditions, flinch, trap or confuse them!
en: \bIn this challenge specifically, you also won't be able to inflict your opponents with status conditions, flinch, trap or confuse them!
it: \bIn questa sfida in particolare, non potrai nemmeno infliggere problemi di stato agli avversari, né farli tentennare, intrappolarli o confonderli!

id: \bLastly, cheese moves like Destiny Bond and Perish Song won't work here; Knock Off also won't knock off their items. Don't try them!
en: \bLastly, cheese moves like Destiny Bond and Perish Song won't work here; Knock Off also won't knock off their items. Don't try them!
it: \bInfine, le mosse furbette come Destinobbligato e Ultimocanto qui non funzionano; e Privazione non toglierà loro gli strumenti. Non provarci nemmeno!

id: \bSince I realised the the difficulty of the Titan Challenge was a mistake, I've given you some buffs to help you out.
en: \bSince I realised the the difficulty of the Titan Challenge was a mistake, I've given you some buffs to help you out.
it: \bDato che mi sono reso conto che la difficoltà della Sfida dei Titani era un errore, ti ho dato qualche potenziamento per aiutarti.

id: \bHowever, your fainted mons will only receive 10% of their max HP regardless of whether or not you have a HP Restoration buff. So keep your mons alive!
en: \bHowever, your fainted mons will only receive 10% of their max HP regardless of whether or not you have a HP Restoration buff. So keep your mons alive!
it: \bTuttavia, i tuoi Pokémon esausti recupereranno solo il 10% dei PS massimi, che tu abbia o no un potenziamento di Recupero PS. Quindi tieni in vita i tuoi Pokémon!

id: \bAlso, they won't be effective here in the Titan Challenge; all opponents are immune to stat drops.
en: \bAlso, they won't be effective here in the Titan Challenge; all opponents are immune to stat drops.
it: \bInoltre, qui nella Sfida dei Titani non saranno efficaci: tutti gli avversari sono immuni ai cali delle statistiche.

id: \bFoul: Why hello there pal!
en: \bFoul: Why hello there pal!
it: \bFoul: Ma salve, amico mio!

id: \bAre you lost?
en: \bAre you lost?
it: \bTi sei perso?

id: \bTook the wrong turn looking for the bathroom? Well don't you worry, just follow me and I will take you back to where you're supposed to be.
en: \bTook the wrong turn looking for the bathroom? Well don't you worry, just follow me and I will take you back to where you're supposed to be.
it: \bHai sbagliato strada cercando il bagno? Beh, non preoccuparti, seguimi e ti riporto dove dovresti essere.

id: \bOh who am I kidding. We both know you're not lost.
en: \bOh who am I kidding. We both know you're not lost.
it: \bMa chi voglio prendere in giro. Sappiamo entrambi che non ti sei perso.

id: \bThis is one of the most secure facilities in this dimension; people don't just get "lost" here.
en: \bThis is one of the most secure facilities in this dimension; people don't just get "lost" here.
it: \bQuesta è una delle strutture più sicure di questa dimensione; la gente non si "perde" qui per caso.

id: \bYour luck seems to have run out now that I've found you before the other two, see, I'm not as nice as them...
en: \bYour luck seems to have run out now that I've found you before the other two, see, I'm not as nice as them...
it: \bSembra che la fortuna ti abbia abbandonato, visto che ti ho trovato prima degli altri due. Vedi, io non sono gentile come loro...

id: \bBut then again, I'm bored.
en: \bBut then again, I'm bored.
it: \bMa d'altra parte, mi annoio.

id: \bEhhh, why not.
en: \bEhhh, why not.
it: \bMah, perché no.

id: \bSee, it would be mean if I defeated you now, but wouldn't it be even meaner if I healed you, just to make you wipe out?
en: \bSee, it would be mean if I defeated you now, but wouldn't it be even meaner if I healed you, just to make you wipe out?
it: \bVedi, sarebbe cattivo da parte mia sconfiggerti adesso, ma non sarebbe ancora più cattivo curarti solo per farti spazzare via?

id: \bLet me show you what I mean by that!
en: \bLet me show you what I mean by that!
it: \bLascia che ti mostri cosa intendo!

id: \bNot too bad, maybe you do have some skills after all.
en: \bNot too bad, maybe you do have some skills after all.
it: \bNon male, forse un po' di talento ce l'hai davvero.

id: \bNow scram and make sure I don't catch you sneaking around here again!
en: \bNow scram and make sure I don't catch you sneaking around here again!
it: \bOra smamma e vedi di non farti più beccare a curiosare da queste parti!

id: \bBut maybe leave a resume on your way out. We might need someone of your talent in the future.
en: \bBut maybe leave a resume on your way out. We might need someone of your talent in the future.
it: \bMa magari lascia un curriculum mentre esci. In futuro potrebbe servirci qualcuno col tuo talento.

id: \bWhat's up, feeling lost? A newcomer would be overwhelmed with this place.
en: \bWhat's up, feeling lost? A newcomer would be overwhelmed with this place.
it: \bChe succede, ti senti spaesato? Un nuovo arrivato si sentirebbe sopraffatto da questo posto.

id: \bLook for Luc, he will tell you what you to expect in Grandeur Club.
en: \bLook for Luc, he will tell you what you to expect in Grandeur Club.
it: \bCerca Luc, ti dirà cosa aspettarti dal Grandeur Club.

id: \bHow're you doin'? I hope you are not surprised by the trainers' standard in Grandeur Club.
en: \bHow're you doin'? I hope you are not surprised by the trainers' standard in Grandeur Club.
it: \bCome te la passi? Spero che il livello degli Allenatori del Grandeur Club non ti abbia sorpreso.

id: \bLook for Luc from time to time to understand rules and regulations of various challenges. Re-evaluate your team if needed.
en: \bLook for Luc from time to time to understand rules and regulations of various challenges. Re-evaluate your team if needed.
it: \bPassa da Luc ogni tanto per capire le regole delle varie sfide. Rivedi la tua squadra, se serve.

id: \bIf you are stuck, farm and grind. You will get there. MUAHAHAHAHAHA!
en: \bIf you are stuck, farm and grind. You will get there.  MUAHAHAHAHAHA!
it: \bSe sei bloccato, allenati e farma. Ce la farai.  MUAHAHAHAHAHA!

id: \rThis challenge is so weird.
en: \rThis challenge is so weird.
it: \rQuesta sfida è proprio strana.

id: \rI don't know if I'm holding my partner back, or if it's the other way round...
en: \rI don't know if I'm holding my partner back, or if it's the other way round...
it: \rNon so se sono io a frenare il mio compagno o se è il contrario...

id: \r*sighs* I guess it's all up to luck, huh?
en: \r*sighs* I guess it's all up to luck, huh?
it: \r*sospira* Immagino sia tutta una questione di fortuna, eh?

id: \bDid you complete the challenges?
en: \bDid you complete the challenges?
it: \bHai completato le sfide?

id: \bI see some trainers come out there from time to time.
en: \bI see some trainers come out there from time to time.
it: \bOgni tanto vedo uscire alcuni Allenatori da lì.

id: \bI wonder what Pokémon they used.
en: \bI wonder what Pokémon they used.
it: \bChissà quali Pokémon hanno usato.

id: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN! Hope you will have a good time in Titan Challenge!
en: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN! Hope you will have a good time in Titan Challenge!
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Buongiorno, \PN! Spero che ti divertirai nella Sfida dei Titani!

id: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN. Your Pokémon look really roughed up.
en: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN. Your Pokémon look really roughed up.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Buongiorno, \PN. I tuoi Pokémon sembrano proprio malconci.

id: \rVermint: Hello \PN, I hope you enjoy your stay here. Try not to think too much about our first encounter, okay?
en: \rVermint: Hello \PN, I hope you enjoy your stay here.  Try not to think too much about our first encounter, okay?
it: \rVermint: Ciao \PN, spero che il soggiorno qui ti piaccia.  Cerca di non pensare troppo al nostro primo incontro, va bene?

id: \rVermint: Hello \PN, I had foreseen that I would have to introduce myself to you.
en: \rVermint: Hello \PN, I had foreseen that I would have to introduce myself to you.
it: \rVermint: Ciao \PN, avevo previsto che avrei dovuto presentarmi a te.

id: \rMy true name is Vera. I created your wardrobe and I am also here to judge your resolve.
en: \rMy true name is Vera. I created your wardrobe and I am also here to judge your resolve.
it: \rIl mio vero nome è Vera. Ho creato il tuo guardaroba e sono qui anche per giudicare la tua determinazione.

id: \rI hope this isn't a shock to you, \PN.
en: \rI hope this isn't a shock to you, \PN.
it: \rSpero che non sia uno shock per te, \PN.

id: The abyss is deep and dark. You shiver as you can feel overwhelming forces enamating from it.
en: The abyss is deep and dark. You shiver as you can feel overwhelming forces enamating from it.
it: L'abisso è profondo e buio. Rabbrividisci, percependo le forze travolgenti che ne emanano.

id: You almost blacked out. It would be a good idea to stay away from it.
en: You almost blacked out. It would be a good idea to stay away from it.
it: Per poco non svieni. Sarebbe meglio starne alla larga.

id: \rNurse Joi: This is the Backstage, a place for you to prep yourself.
en: \rNurse Joi: This is the Backstage, a place for you to prep yourself.
it: \rInfermiera Joi: Questo è il Backstage, un posto dove prepararti.

id: \rOnce you're ready, head to the top for your next challenge!
en: \rOnce you're ready, head to the top for your next challenge!
it: \rQuando sei pronto, sali in cima per la tua prossima sfida!

id: \bDon't mind me, I'm just mentally preparing myself before going in.
en: \bDon't mind me, I'm just mentally preparing myself before going in.
it: \bNon badare a me, mi sto solo preparando mentalmente prima di entrare.

id: \bI'llwinthistime, I'llwinthistime, I'llwinthistime, I'llwinthistime!
en: \bI'llwinthistime, I'llwinthistime, I'llwinthistime, I'llwinthistime!
it: \bStavoltavinco, stavoltavinco, stavoltavinco, stavoltavinco!

id: An ominous Vending Machine stares at you. Best not to go near it.
en: An ominous Vending Machine stares at you. Best not to go near it.
it: Un Distributore inquietante ti fissa. Meglio non avvicinarsi.

id: PLEASE INSERT YOUR GC PAD TO ACCESS ENEMY SYGNA BUFFS...
en: PLEASE INSERT YOUR GC PAD TO ACCESS ENEMY SYGNA BUFFS...
it: INSERIRE IL PROPRIO GC PAD PER ACCEDERE AI POTENZIAMENTI SYGNA NEMICI...

id: WELCOME [\PN]!
en: WELCOME [\PN]!
it: BENVENUTO [\PN]!

id: You can't seem to get the Vending Machine to work anymore. Maybe it can only be used before starting a challenge?
en: You can't seem to get the Vending Machine to work anymore. Maybe it can only be used before starting a challenge?
it: Non riesci più a far funzionare il Distributore. Forse si può usare solo prima di iniziare una sfida?

id: The exit seems to be locked...
en: The exit seems to be locked...
it: L'uscita sembra chiusa a chiave...

id: \bThis is a great place to level up your Pokemon to Lv100!
en: \bThis is a great place to level up your Pokemon to Lv100!
it: \bQuesto è un posto ideale per portare i tuoi Pokémon al Lv. 100!

id: \bHitsukid made this challenge just for that reason in mind!
en: \bHitsukid made this challenge just for that reason in mind!
it: \bHitsukid ha creato questa sfida proprio con questo scopo!

id: \rI heard a rumour that once upon a time, there were no difficulties for this challenge and that trainers would stack on top of Nurse Joy.
en: \rI heard a rumour that once upon a time, there were no difficulties for this challenge and that trainers would stack on top of Nurse Joy.
it: \rHo sentito dire che un tempo questa sfida non aveva livelli di difficoltà e che gli Allenatori si accalcavano addosso all'Infermiera Joy.

id: \rTerrifying, right? I'm glad that it doesn't happen anymore, if it did.
en: \rTerrifying, right? I'm glad that it doesn't happen anymore, if it did.
it: \rTerrificante, vero? Sono contenta che non succeda più, ammesso che sia mai successo.

id: \bAsh
en: \bAsh
it: \bAsh

id: \bLance
en: \bLance
it: \bLance

id: \bBrawly
en: \bBrawly
it: \bBrawly

id: \bLuc-ker: Oh, you want to battle me at my full power? Fine, but don't say you weren't warned.
en: \bLuc-ker: Oh, you want to battle me at my full power? Fine, but don't say you weren't warned.
it: \bLuc-ker: Oh, vuoi lottare contro di me al massimo della mia potenza? Va bene, ma poi non dire che non ti avevo avvertito.

id: \bLuc: Too easy, huh? I lied - that wasn't actually my full power.
en: \bLuc: Too easy, huh? I lied - that wasn't actually my full power.
it: \bLuc: Troppo facile, eh? Ho mentito: quella non era davvero tutta la mia potenza.

id: \bMy real master, Yhwach, gifted me with the shift V - The Visionary, turning my imagination into reality! That means I can throw at you whatever I can conjure and I simply haven't had enough to imagine yet.
en: \bMy real master, Yhwach, gifted me with the shift V - The Visionary, turning my imagination into reality! That means I can throw at you whatever I can conjure and I simply haven't had enough to imagine yet.
it: \bIl mio vero maestro, Yhwach, mi ha donato lo shift V - The Visionary, che trasforma la mia immaginazione in realtà! Significa che posso scagliarti contro qualunque cosa riesca a evocare, e semplicemente non ho ancora immaginato abbastanza.

id: \bUntil next time!
en: \bUntil next time!
it: \bAlla prossima!

id: \bLuc: Hehe, that's a taste of what's to come soon. Thanks for letting me go all-out!
en: \bLuc: Hehe, that's a taste of what's to come soon. Thanks for letting me go all-out!
it: \bLuc: Ehehe, questo è un assaggio di ciò che arriverà presto. Grazie per avermi lasciato dare il massimo!

id: It's a Vending Machine. Is it like all the other ones in the main lobby?
en: It's a Vending Machine. Is it like all the other ones in the main lobby?
it: È un Distributore. Sarà come tutti gli altri nella hall principale?

id: PLEASE INSERT YOUR GC PAD TO ACCESS SYGNA BUFFS...
en: PLEASE INSERT YOUR GC PAD TO ACCESS SYGNA BUFFS...
it: INSERIRE IL PROPRIO GC PAD PER ACCEDERE AI POTENZIAMENTI SYGNA...

en: YOU HAVE \v[80] CREDITS IN YOUR ACCOUNT. PLEASE SELECT AN OPTION. \ch[98,-1,Buff shop,View active buffs,View unlocked buffs,Add buff, Remove active buff,Clear active buffs,Close menu]

en: YOU HAVE BOUGHT ALL BUFFS AVAILABLE.
it: HAI ACQUISTATO TUTTI I POTENZIAMENTI DISPONIBILI.

id: YOU HAVE NO ACTIVE BUFFS.
en: YOU HAVE NO ACTIVE BUFFS.
it: NON HAI POTENZIAMENTI ATTIVI.

en: YOU HAVE NO MORE UNLOCKED BUFFS.
it: NON HAI ALTRI POTENZIAMENTI SBLOCCATI.

id: ACTIVE BUFFS CLEARED.
en: ACTIVE BUFFS CLEARED.
it: POTENZIAMENTI ATTIVI AZZERATI.

id: Oh dear, looks like you don't have enough Pokémon to battle. Talk to Nurse Joy to get patched up.
en: Oh dear, looks like you don't have enough Pokémon to battle. Talk to Nurse Joy to get patched up.
it: Oh cielo, sembra che tu non abbia abbastanza Pokémon per lottare. Parla con l'Infermiera Joy per rimetterti in sesto.

id: \bPsst! Want to know a secret?
en: \bPsst! Want to know a secret?
it: \bPsst! Vuoi sapere un segreto?

id: \bI heard that Luc-ker nearly went insane trying to get trainers from Pasio here for this challenge.
en: \bI heard that Luc-ker nearly went insane trying to get trainers from Pasio here for this challenge.
it: \bHo sentito che Luc-ker è quasi impazzito per portare qui gli Allenatori di Pasio per questa sfida.

id: \bAnd oh boy did it work out for him. Now we have these monstrosities disguised as "challenges".
en: \bAnd oh boy did it work out for him. Now we have these monstrosities disguised as "challenges".
it: \bE accidenti se ci è riuscito. Ora abbiamo queste mostruosità travestite da "sfide".

id: \bThey're not even "challenges", they're just straight up bullying!
en: \bThey're not even "challenges", they're just straight up bullying!
it: \bNon sono nemmeno "sfide", sono puro e semplice bullismo!

id: \bI guess the one saving grace is the existence of blessings... an idea he got after playing far too much of a rougue-like mode in a certain game.
en: \bI guess the one saving grace is the existence of blessings... an idea he got after playing far too much of a rougue-like mode in a certain game.
it: \bImmagino che l'unica nota positiva sia l'esistenza delle benedizioni... un'idea che gli è venuta dopo aver giocato fin troppo a una modalità roguelike di un certo gioco.

id: \bHaha, your loss then.
en: \bHaha, your loss then.
it: \bAhah, peggio per te allora.

id: \rDid you know that there's a way to get to the higher floors?
en: \rDid you know that there's a way to get to the higher floors?
it: \rLo sapevi che c'è un modo per arrivare ai piani superiori?

id: \rI hear that only strong trainers or certain VIPs will have access to it.
en: \rI hear that only strong trainers or certain VIPs will have access to it.
it: \rHo sentito che solo gli Allenatori forti o certi VIP possono accedervi.

id: \rHow do you know if you're strong? I heard another rumour that, if you get good in Club, and I mean real good in Club, they'll acknowledge you.
en: \rHow do you know if you're strong? I heard another rumour that, if you get good in Club, and I mean real good in Club, they'll acknowledge you.
it: \rCome fai a sapere se sei forte? Ho sentito un'altra voce: se diventi bravo nella Sfida Club, e intendo davvero bravo, ti riconosceranno.

id: \rHope you will be one to get there. All the best!
en: \rHope you will be one to get there. All the best!
it: \rSpero che tu sia uno di quelli che ci arrivano. In bocca al lupo!

id: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN! Hope the Duet Challenge is not giving you a tough time!
en: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN! Hope the Duet Challenge is not giving you a tough time!
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Buongiorno, \PN! Spero che la Sfida Duetto non ti stia dando troppo filo da torcere!

id: \rApologies if you are looking for a heal. This service is not available in the Duet Challenge.
en: \rApologies if you are looking for a heal. This service is not available in the Duet Challenge.
it: \rMi dispiace se cercavi delle cure. Questo servizio non è disponibile nella Sfida Duetto.

id: \rHey! You cant afford my service! Get blacked out and outta here!
en: \rHey! You cant afford my service! Get blacked out and outta here!
it: \rEhi! Non puoi permetterti il mio servizio! Va' a svenire da qualche altra parte e sparisci!

id: \rHmm... what blessings should I use?
en: \rHmm... what blessings should I use?
it: \rMmh... quali benedizioni dovrei usare?

id: \rI could use "Assassin's Blessing" for that extra speed so that my Lucario has enough speed to outspeed almost everything...
en: \rI could use "Assassin's Blessing" for that extra speed so that my Lucario has enough speed to outspeed almost everything...
it: \rPotrei usare la "Benedizione dell'Assassino" per avere quella velocità in più, così il mio Lucario sarebbe abbastanza veloce da superare quasi tutti...

id: \bBut I also need it to hit hard enough, so I want "Warrior's Blessing"... or should I swap to a special set and use "Warlock's Blessing" to power up my Regieleki even further...?
en: \bBut I also need it to hit hard enough, so I want "Warrior's Blessing"... or should I swap to a special set and use "Warlock's Blessing" to power up my Regieleki even further...?
it: \bMa mi serve anche che colpisca forte, quindi voglio la "Benedizione del Guerriero"... o dovrei passare a un set speciale e usare la "Benedizione dello Stregone" per potenziare ancora di più il mio Regieleki...?

id: \rAh, but then I can't get Unflappable to deal with whatever <i>that<\i> is... ugh. Maybe just Lv 2 on one of my blessings then?
en: \rAh, but then I can't get Unflappable to deal with whatever <i>that<\i> is... ugh. Maybe just Lv 2 on one of my blessings then?
it: \rAh, ma così non posso prendere Imperturbabile per gestire qualunque cosa sia <i>quella<\i>... uff. Magari allora solo Lv. 2 su una delle mie benedizioni?

id: \rHuh? You don't know what I'm talking about? Hahaha, you haven't lost to them, have you?
en: \rHuh? You don't know what I'm talking about?  Hahaha, you haven't lost to them, have you?
it: \rEh? Non sai di cosa sto parlando?  Ahahah, non hai ancora perso contro di loro, vero?

id: \rYou're either really good, or you haven't been whooped yet. Either way, have fun!
en: \rYou're either really good, or you haven't been whooped yet. Either way, have fun!
it: \rO sei davvero bravo, o non ti hanno ancora stracciato. In ogni caso, divertiti!

id: \bOnly authorized staffs are permitted to enter.
en: \bOnly authorized staffs are permitted to enter.
it: \bL'accesso è consentito solo al personale autorizzato.

id: \ch[98,-1,Display your Staff Pass,Walk Away]
en: \ch[98,-1,Display your Staff Pass,Walk Away]
it: \ch[98,-1,Mostra il Pass Staff,Vai via]

id: \bOh, you are one of the staff here? You should have show me your pass earlier. Please enter.
en: \bOh, you are one of the staff here? You should have show me your pass earlier. Please enter.
it: \bOh, fai parte dello staff? Avresti dovuto mostrarmi il pass prima. Prego, entra pure.

id: \bPlease leave. Thank you.
en: \bPlease leave. Thank you.
it: \bTi prego di andartene. Grazie.

id: \bFoul: Hello! Glad to see that you are finally here. In case you don't recognise me, my name is Foul Play at A Garbodor Price, but my friends call me Foul.
en: \bFoul: Hello! Glad to see that you are finally here. In case you don't recognise me, my name is Foul Play at A Garbodor Price, but my friends call me Foul.
it: \bFoul: Ciao! Che piacere vedere che finalmente sei arrivato. Se non mi riconosci, mi chiamo Foul Play at A Garbodor Price, ma gli amici mi chiamano Foul.

id: \bI am one of the few people to be chosen here before you to test my strength against this place. And I can tell you from experience that you are gonna have a lot of fun, or not. It depends on you after all.
en: \bI am one of the few people to be chosen here before you to test my strength against this place. And I can tell you from experience that you are gonna have a lot of fun, or not. It depends on you after all.
it: \bSono una delle poche persone scelte prima di te per mettere alla prova la propria forza in questo posto. E posso dirti per esperienza che ti divertirai un sacco, oppure no. Dopotutto dipende da te.

id: \bTonnes of huge experimental vessels containing floating specimens in colourful bubbly liquids can be seen.
en: \bTonnes of huge experimental vessels containing floating specimens in colourful bubbly liquids can be seen.
it: \bSi vedono tantissime enormi vasche sperimentali con esemplari che galleggiano in liquidi colorati e pieni di bolle.

id: \bMan, I love this challenge despite how hard it is.
en: \bMan, I love this challenge despite how hard it is.
it: \bAmico, adoro questa sfida nonostante sia così difficile.

id: \bThe different trainers you get to face, their unique gimmicks, their drip and even the blessings you get to use.
en: \bThe different trainers you get to face, their unique gimmicks, their drip and even the blessings you get to use.
it: \bI diversi Allenatori che affronti, i loro trucchi unici, il loro stile e persino le benedizioni che puoi usare.

id: \bIt's beautiful. :')
en: \bIt's beautiful. :')
it: \bÈ bellissima. :')

id: \bHi, this is the entrance for the CLUB CHALLENGE. Would you like to enter?
en: \bHi, this is the entrance for the CLUB CHALLENGE.  Would you like to enter?
it: \bSalve, questo è l'ingresso della SFIDA CLUB.  Vuoi entrare?

id: \bHi, this is the entry for MAYHEM CHALLENGE. Would you like to enter?
en: \bHi, this is the entry for MAYHEM CHALLENGE. Would you like to enter?

en: \bHow strange. You don't seem to have a backstage pass. Try buying one again.

id: \bPlease let me escort you.
en: \bPlease let me escort you.
it: \bPermettimi di scortarti.
