en: \bFor this run, you'll have your bag, but you'll have a preset amount of items. Don't worry, you'll get your bag back soon enough.
it: \bIn questa partita avrai la tua Borsa, ma con una quantità prestabilita di strumenti. Non preoccuparti, riavrai presto la tua Borsa.

id: \bIntriguing coloured-specimens can be seen.
en: \bIntriguing coloured-specimens can be seen.
it: \bSi vedono degli intriganti esemplari colorati.

id: \bOut of bou...... hmmmm? Let me answer this call.
en: \bOut of bou...... hmmmm? Let me answer this call.
it: \bVietato l'acce...... mmmh? Devo rispondere a questa chiamata.

id: \bYes sir? Yes. Yes. He is here. Roger.
en: \bYes sir? Yes. Yes. He is here. Roger.
it: \bSì, signore? Sì. Sì. È qui. Ricevuto.

id: \bApologies. You may enter and access the higher floor as of now. Please.
en: \bApologies. You may enter and access the higher floor as of now. Please.
it: \bChiedo scusa. Da questo momento puoi entrare e accedere al piano superiore. Prego.

id: \bHope you're having fun in the Grandeur Club, \PN!
en: \bHope you're having fun in the Grandeur Club, \PN!
it: \bSpero che ti stia divertendo al Grandeur Club, \PN!

id: \bWant to refresh yourself on a challenge?
en: \bWant to refresh yourself on a challenge?
it: \bVuoi un ripasso su una delle sfide?

id: \bYo! I'm Luc-ker, nice to meet you, \PN! (The hyphen is important by the way.)
en: \bYo! I'm Luc-ker, nice to meet you, \PN! (The hyphen is important by the way.)
it: \bEhi! Sono Luc-ker, piacere di conoscerti, \PN! (Il trattino è importante, comunque.)

id: \bHmm? How do I know your name? Ahahaha, don't worry about the specifics. By the way, you can call me Luc for short if my full name is too hard for you.
en: \bHmm? How do I know your name? Ahahaha, don't worry about the specifics. By the way, you can call me Luc for short if my full name is too hard for you.
it: \bMmh? Come faccio a sapere il tuo nome? Ahahah, non preoccuparti dei dettagli. Comunque, puoi chiamarmi Luc per brevità, se il mio nome completo è troppo difficile per te.

id: \bAnyway, I'm here to help you out by giving you some information on the challenges, as Hitsu wants me to.
en: \bAnyway, I'm here to help you out by giving you some information on the challenges, as Hitsu wants me to.
it: \bComunque, sono qui per aiutarti dandoti qualche informazione sulle sfide, come vuole Hitsu.

id: \bYou'd better jot them down on a piece of paper, instead of just spamming confirm!
en: \bYou'd better jot them down on a piece of paper, instead of just spamming confirm!
it: \bFaresti meglio ad appuntartele su un foglio, invece di premere conferma a raffica!

id: \bThere's 6 main challenges to take on in the Grandeur Club. Which one would you like to know about?
en: \bThere's 6 main challenges to take on in the Grandeur Club. Which one would you like to know about?
it: \bCi sono 6 sfide principali da affrontare nel Grandeur Club. Di quale vorresti sapere qualcosa?

id: \ch[1,-1,Club Challenge, Practice Challenge, Gauntlet Challenge, Mayhem Challenge,Sync Challenge, Titan Challenge,Finish]
en: \ch[1,-1,Club Challenge, Practice Challenge, Gauntlet Challenge, Mayhem Challenge,Sync Challenge, Titan Challenge,Finish]
it: \ch[1,-1,Sfida Club, Sfida Allenamento, Sfida Resistenza, Sfida Caos,Sfida Sync, Sfida dei Titani,Fine]

id: \bThe Club Challenge - here, you can battle characters from the main series games.
en: \bThe Club Challenge - here, you can battle characters from the main series games.
it: \bLa Sfida Club: qui puoi lottare contro i personaggi dei giochi della serie principale.

id: \bIf you can battle characters from the anime and Pokémon Adventures, then why not the same for the main series games as well?
en: \bIf you can battle characters from the anime and Pokémon Adventures, then why not the same for the main series games as well?
it: \bSe puoi lottare contro i personaggi dell'anime e di Pokémon Adventures, perché non fare lo stesso anche con quelli della serie principale?

id: \bYou'll be facing Lv 90 Pokémon in a 3v3 battle. If you do well enough, you might get some... *ahem* privileges.
en: \bYou'll be facing Lv 90 Pokémon in a 3v3 battle.  If you do well enough, you might get some... *ahem* privileges.
it: \bAffronterai Pokémon di Lv. 90 in lotte 3 contro 3.  Se te la cavi abbastanza bene, potresti ottenere qualche... *ehm* privilegio.

id: \bAnything else you would like to know?
en: \bAnything else you would like to know?
it: \bC'è altro che vorresti sapere?

id: \bThe Practice Challenge. If the Club Challenge is too difficult for you, try this challenge!
en: \bThe Practice Challenge. If the Club Challenge is too difficult for you, try this challenge!
it: \bLa Sfida Allenamento. Se la Sfida Club è troppo difficile per te, prova questa!

id: \bSimilar to Club Challenge, but the Pokémon are at Lv 75 and hold no items, so it's a good place to grind your Pokémon!
en: \bSimilar to Club Challenge, but the Pokémon are at Lv 75 and hold no items, so it's a good place to grind your Pokémon!
it: \bÈ simile alla Sfida Club, ma i Pokémon sono di Lv. 75 e non tengono strumenti, quindi è un buon posto per allenare i tuoi Pokémon!

id: \bThe Gauntlet Challenge, the challenge that chucks trainers at you until your team drops (or until you defeat 150 trainers).
en: \bThe Gauntlet Challenge, the challenge that chucks trainers at you until your team drops (or until you defeat 150 trainers).
it: \bLa Sfida Resistenza, la sfida che ti lancia contro Allenatori finché la tua squadra non crolla (o finché non sconfiggi 150 Allenatori).

id: \bYou will be facing Lv 100 Pokémon in a 3v3 battle, with benefits at certain intervals to help you build your win streak.
en: \bYou will be facing Lv 100 Pokémon in a 3v3 battle, with benefits at certain intervals to help you build your win streak.
it: \bAffronterai Pokémon di Lv. 100 in lotte 3 contro 3, con dei vantaggi a intervalli regolari per aiutarti ad allungare la tua serie di vittorie.

id: \bYour longest, most glorious run will be logged for you so you can boast in Discord with fellow players, so whip out the big guns!
en: \bYour longest, most glorious run will be logged for you so you can boast in Discord with fellow players, so whip out the big guns!
it: \bLa tua serie più lunga e gloriosa verrà registrata, così potrai vantartene su Discord con gli altri giocatori, quindi tira fuori l'artiglieria pesante!

id: \bThe Mayhem Challenge - in this one, you battle with trainers in a full battles and they have all Lv 100 Pokémon.
en: \bThe Mayhem Challenge - in this one, you battle with trainers in a full battles and they have all Lv 100 Pokémon.
it: \bLa Sfida Caos: in questa lotti contro Allenatori in lotte complete, e hanno tutti Pokémon di Lv. 100.

id: \bIf you pay attention, you'll realise that even if you face the same trainer on next run, their team line-up is hardly the same!
en: \bIf you pay attention, you'll realise that even if you face the same trainer on next run, their team line-up is hardly the same!
it: \bSe fai attenzione, ti accorgerai che anche se affronti lo stesso Allenatore nella partita successiva, la sua squadra non è quasi mai la stessa!

id: \bThat's because they're holding a pool of Pokémon awaiting for your arrival. You'll never know what's up their sleeves!
en: \bThat's because they're holding a pool of Pokémon awaiting for your arrival. You'll never know what's up their sleeves!
it: \bQuesto perché hanno una riserva di Pokémon che aspetta il tuo arrivo. Non saprai mai che assi hanno nella manica!

id: \bThey have high IVs as well, so you'd better bring your best 6, because THIS IS MADNESS!
en: \bThey have high IVs as well, so you'd better bring your best 6, because THIS IS MADNESS!
it: \bHanno anche IV alti, quindi faresti meglio a portare i tuoi 6 migliori, perché QUESTA È FOLLIA!

id: \bThe Sync Challenge; you'll battle "Sygna Suit" trainers (and other outfits) from the hit mobile game "Pokémon Masters EX" in 3v3 triple battles.
en: \bThe Sync Challenge; you'll battle "Sygna Suit" trainers (and other outfits) from the hit mobile game "Pokémon Masters EX" in 3v3 triple battles.
it: \bLa Sfida Sync: lotterai contro Allenatori in "Sygna Suit" (e con altri costumi) del famoso gioco per cellulari "Pokémon Masters EX" in lotte in triplo 3 contro 3.

id: \bTheir Pokémon may also have special gimmicks, for example not needing to recharge after using a move with high base power, or not being able to miss attacks.
en: \bTheir Pokémon may also have special gimmicks, for example not needing to recharge after using a move with high base power, or not being able to miss attacks.
it: \bI loro Pokémon possono anche avere trucchi speciali, per esempio non doversi ricaricare dopo aver usato una mossa con potenza base alta, o non poter mancare gli attacchi.

id: \bYou'd better bring your lucky charm, the challenge is real!
en: \bYou'd better bring your lucky charm, the challenge is real!
it: \bFaresti meglio a portarti il tuo portafortuna, la sfida è seria!

id: \bThe Titan challenge you'll be battling Sync Pokémon, also known as Titans, in a 6v1 triple battle. <s>This was made before Scarlet and Violet, way before they thought it was cool.</s>
en: \bThe Titan challenge you'll be battling Sync Pokémon, also known as Titans, in a 6v1 triple battle. <s>This was made before Scarlet and Violet, way before they thought it was cool.</s>
it: \bNella Sfida Titani lotterai contro Pokémon Sincro, detti anche Titani, in una lotta in triplo 6 contro 1. <s>Questa l'abbiamo fatta prima di Scarlatto e Violetto, molto prima che diventasse di moda.</s>

id: \bThey'll be retaining their gimmick from the Sync Challenge, but they're much tankier, and you can't rely on AOE moves.
en: \bThey'll be retaining their gimmick from the Sync Challenge, but they're much tankier, and you can't rely on AOE moves.
it: \bManterranno i trucchi della Sfida Sync, ma sono molto più resistenti e non puoi contare sulle mosse ad area.

id: \bHitsu's idea is this is to mimic the scenario of Quest Raids from certain RPG games. So ready up, and go for the head!
en: \bHitsu's idea is this is to mimic the scenario of Quest Raids from certain RPG games. So ready up, and go for the head!
it: \bL'idea di Hitsu è riprodurre i raid di certi giochi di ruolo. Quindi preparati e mira alla testa!

id: \bPhew! Thanks for that. Good luck out there!
en: \bPhew! Thanks for that. Good luck out there!
it: \bFiuu! Grazie per avermi ascoltato. Buona fortuna là fuori!

id: \bWhat the heck.
en: \bWhat the heck.
it: \bMa che diavolo.

id: \bI took my Necrozma to the Hyper Trainer to max out its IVs. It has 252 EVs in Special Attack. It's Modest.
en: \bI took my Necrozma to the Hyper Trainer to max out its IVs. It has 252 EVs in Special Attack. It's Modest.
it: \bHo portato il mio Necrozma dal Mister dell'Allenamento Decisivo per massimizzare i suoi IV. Ha 252 EV in Attacco Speciale. È di natura Modesta.

id: \bSO WHY THE HECK, AFTER ULTRA BURSTING, IS ITS Z-MOVE ONLY HITTING FOR 30-35% ON MISTY'S POKÉMON???
en: \bSO WHY THE HECK, AFTER ULTRA BURSTING, IS ITS Z-MOVE ONLY HITTING FOR 30-35% ON MISTY'S POKÉMON???
it: \bE ALLORA PERCHÉ DIAVOLO, DOPO L'ULTRAESPLOSIONE, LA SUA MOSSA Z TOGLIE SOLO IL 30-35% AI POKÉMON DI MISTY???

id: \bARGHHHHHH!
en: \bARGHHHHHH!
it: \bARGHHHHHH!

id: \bShow me your best!
en: \bShow me your best!
it: \bMostrami il meglio di te!

id: \bBrock: The world is huge. There are still many strong trainers like you.
en: \bBrock: The world is huge. There are still many strong trainers like you.
it: \bBrock: Il mondo è enorme. Ci sono ancora molti Allenatori forti come te.

id: \bI have faith that you will overcome them!
en: \bI have faith that you will overcome them!
it: \bSono sicuro che riuscirai a superarli!

id: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN. Your team looks really roughed up.
en: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN. Your team looks really roughed up.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Buongiorno, \PN. La tua squadra sembra proprio malconcia.

id: \rThe unit behind me broke down, so that's no more healing for you for the rest of the challenge, for better or worse.
en: \rThe unit behind me broke down, so that's no more healing for you for the rest of the challenge, for better or worse.
it: \rIl macchinario dietro di me si è rotto, quindi niente più cure per te per il resto della sfida, nel bene e nel male.

id: \rCome back again next time!
en: \rCome back again next time!
it: \rTorna a trovarci la prossima volta!

id: \rThe unit is all charged up. Let's heal your team, shall we?
en: \rThe unit is all charged up. Let's heal your team, shall we?
it: \rIl macchinario è carico. Curiamo la tua squadra, che ne dici?

id: \rAll's great now! Put your best foot out, ok?
en: \rAll's great now! Put your best foot out, ok?
it: \rOra è tutto a posto! Dai il meglio di te, ok?

id: \rHehe, desperate yea? I could heal you up with the unit behind me, but it is still not ready yet.
en: \rHehe, desperate yea? I could heal you up with the unit behind me, but it is still not ready yet.
it: \rEhehe, disperato, eh? Potrei curarti col macchinario dietro di me, ma non è ancora pronto.

id: \rSheeeeeeeesh.
en: \rSheeeeeeeesh.
it: \rAccidentiiiiiii.

id: \rEither these Titans have a ridiculous amount of health and/or defenses, or our damage is being reduced by an insane amount.
en: \rEither these Titans have a ridiculous amount of health and/or defenses, or our damage is being reduced by an insane amount.
it: \rO questi Titani hanno una quantità ridicola di PS e/o difese, o i nostri danni vengono ridotti in modo assurdo.

id: \rWelp. Either way, it sure feels like I'm facing a JRPG boss every time.
en: \rWelp. Either way, it sure feels like I'm facing a JRPG boss every time.
it: \rBeh. In ogni caso, ogni volta sembra proprio di affrontare un boss di un JRPG.

id: \rHeh. No matter how many times you do this challenge, there are no two identical runs.
en: \rHeh. No matter how many times you do this challenge, there are no two identical runs.
it: \rEh. Non importa quante volte affronti questa sfida, non ci sono mai due partite identiche.

id: \rWell, ok. Maybe there is, but it's like a 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000001% chance.
en: \rWell, ok. Maybe there is, but it's like a 0.000000000000000000000000000000000000001% chance.
it: \rVa bene, ok. Magari sì, ma con una probabilità tipo dello 0,000000000000000000000000000000000000001%.

id: \bLike, seriously. There are so many trainers and their teams might not even be the same each time, even if you face the same trainer.
en: \bLike, seriously. There are so many trainers and their teams might not even be the same each time, even if you face the same trainer.
it: \bCioè, sul serio. Ci sono tantissimi Allenatori e le loro squadre potrebbero non essere uguali ogni volta, anche se affronti lo stesso Allenatore.

id: \rAND it might not even be in the same order or rooms as in the previous run, even if the trainers are the same.
en: \rAND it might not even be in the same order or rooms as in the previous run, even if the trainers are the same.
it: \rE potrebbero non essere nemmeno nello stesso ordine o nelle stesse stanze della partita precedente, anche se gli Allenatori sono gli stessi.

en: \bCongrats, you made it through the PRACTICE CHALLENGE!

en: \bDo compete again for more rewards!

en: \bYou may exit by following the arrow sign; it's best not to loiter around this area. Alright?

id: \bAh, the challenges here are way tougher than expected.
en: \bAh, the challenges here are way tougher than expected.
it: \bAh, le sfide qui sono molto più dure del previsto.

id: \bI am kinda bummed about it.
en: \bI am kinda bummed about it.
it: \bCi sono rimasto un po' male.

id: \bHow about you? Are you up for it?
en: \bHow about you? Are you up for it?
it: \bE tu? Te la senti?

id: \bHow's it going? Bet you're doing great!
en: \bHow's it going? Bet you're doing great!
it: \bCome va? Scommetto che te la stai cavando alla grande!

id: \bYou will overcome and make your way back here again. Right?
en: \bYou will overcome and make your way back here again. Right?
it: \bCe la farai e tornerai di nuovo qui. Giusto?

id: \bHmm. It's so hard to formulate a strategy for each trainer.
en: \bHmm. It's so hard to formulate a strategy for each trainer.
it: \bMmm. È difficilissimo elaborare una strategia per ogni Allenatore.

id: \bThing is, there's no such thing as a "perfect lead". You could lead off with a Ferrothorn and it would do amazing against Marlon, but then it would get one shot from any of Flint's Pokémon.
en: \bThing is, there's no such thing as a "perfect lead". You could lead off with a Ferrothorn and it would do amazing against Marlon, but then it would get one shot from any of Flint's Pokémon.
it: \bIl punto è che non esiste un "primo Pokémon perfetto". Potresti iniziare con un Ferrothorn e andrebbe alla grande contro Marlon, ma poi verrebbe messo KO in un colpo da qualsiasi Pokémon di Flint.

id: \bAnd then you'd have to waste items... or even worse, have one less Pokémon for the rest of the battles.
en: \bAnd then you'd have to waste items... or even worse, have one less Pokémon for the rest of the battles.
it: \bE allora dovresti sprecare strumenti... o peggio ancora, avere un Pokémon in meno per il resto delle lotte.

id: \rWow, this is delicious! One more on the go please!
en: \rWow, this is delicious! One more on the go please!
it: \rWow, è buonissimo! Un altro da portar via, per favore!

id: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN! Hope you are taking this chance to grind your Pokemon up to tip-top!
en: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN! Hope you are taking this chance to grind your Pokemon up to tip-top!
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Buongiorno, \PN! Spero che tu stia approfittando dell'occasione per allenare i tuoi Pokémon al massimo!

id: \r..........hope you are not coming here for a quick heal, yeah?
en: \r..........hope you are not coming here for a quick heal, yeah?
it: \r..........spero che tu non sia venuto qui per una cura veloce, eh?

id: \rWow... Erm, this service is not available in the Practice Challenge. Apologies for that.
en: \rWow... Erm, this service is not available in the Practice Challenge. Apologies for that.
it: \rOh... Ehm, questo servizio non è disponibile nella Sfida Allenamento. Ci scusiamo.

id: \rDo your very best... alright?
en: \rDo your very best... alright?
it: \rDai il massimo... d'accordo?

id: \rNurse Joy: Great! You go and get those wins, \PN!
en: \rNurse Joy: Great! You go and get those wins, \PN!
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Fantastico! Vai a conquistarti quelle vittorie, \PN!

id: \bThis is inhumane. I might call it a day.
en: \bThis is inhumane. I might call it a day.
it: \bÈ disumano. Credo che per oggi mi fermo qui.

id: \bI was fired from my job last month.
en: \bI was fired from my job last month.
it: \bIl mese scorso mi hanno licenziato.

en: \bNow I have nothing better to do than grind this. My longest win streak is 70... healing is a lot less frequent the higher you go.
it: \bOra non ho niente di meglio da fare che grindare qui. La mia serie di vittorie più lunga è 70... più sali, meno spesso ti curano.

en: \bHi, this is the entrance for the GAUNTLET CHALLENGE.  Your highest win count is \v[93].
it: \bCiao, questo è l'ingresso della GAUNTLET CHALLENGE.  Il tuo record di vittorie è \v[93].

id: \bWould you like to enter?
